name: Right specification at the right time
principle: For any new use case or input, whoever applies a project's specifications works from the few that bear on it, at a small fraction of the cost of reading them all.
state_description: A person or an AI starting on a new request has in front of it the specifications that bear on it, each with its linked records, and none that do not. Nothing relevant is missed, and nothing is read in full that was not needed.
hints_of_measurement: For labelled requests, the expected records are among the top few results, and the scan of every record is a small fraction of the records' full size.

name: Shared specification search
principle: An application that finds specifications for a request writes only what is its own, and every improvement to finding them reaches it without a change on its side.
state_description: An application's code for finding specifications holds only its own parts, such as its vector search and its judging prompt. When finding specifications improves in the library, every application that relies on it gets the improvement on its next upgrade.
hints_of_measurement: Offline cases over the live records pass, and an adopter holds no function that reads the same with its domain words removed.
